title: The viewer fixture CF-05 still expects the log legend from before push entries were added
foundBy: session agent, running `make fixtures` with a local browser
details: `make fixtures` fails one check, CF-05, which records the dispatch viewer's legend rows. In all four synthetic archives the orchestrator-log row now ends with "push delivered" and "push refused". Commit 4513d85 added those entries for SAC-092, and the expectation was not re-recorded with it. Every other check passes or meets its target. The suite needs a browser and CI does not run it, so nothing reported the failure.
